name: URI Summer Music Academy
operator_name: University of Rhode Island Music Department
street_address: URI Kingston campus, 105 Upper College Road
description_short: A one or two week band, orchestra and choir camp on URI's Kingston campus for students who have finished grades 7 to 12, with ensembles, studio classes and theory, as residents in campus dorms or as commuters.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellation fee is 50% of tuition from June 19 to June 30, 2027 and 100% from July 1 to August 1, 2027.
notes: Open to voice, string, woodwind, brass and percussion students who have completed grades 7 to 12 by June 2027 (grade_min and grade_max are grades completed). No auditions; placement video due June 18, 2027. Commuter tuition: $1,050 week 1, $1,200 week 2, $2,250 both. $50 NAfME or sibling discount. Residents stay in air conditioned apartment style dorms. Register by June 18, 2027.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Home page: July 18 to August 1, 2027; must have completed grades 7 to 12 in June 2027; 2027 tuition residential $1,675 / $1,875 / $3,500 (week 1 / week 2 / both), commuter $1,050 / $1,200 / $2,250; residents get 3 meals, commuters lunch and dinner. Street and zip are the URI Music Department address on this page. price_per_week is the residential week 1 rate
